 Amazon’s Black Friday Deals Are Here—Including Record-Low Prices on Apple and Dyson 
 Follow Sales & Shopping News View feed Amazon’s Black Friday Deals Are Here—Including Record-Low Prices on Apple and Dyson 
 Handpicked by an editor who tracks deals all year long.
 By Lauren Gruber Published: Nov 19, 2026 11:33 AM EST Save Article Share Article We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 3 min read As an editor who writes about sales all year long, Black Friday is basically my Super Bowl. Amazon’s 12-day shopping marathon (dubbed T-12, or Turkey 12 for the uninitiated) is finally here, which means that there’s no need to wait until Black Friday to score holiday discounts. I’ve been tracking prices on the e-tailer’s most sought-after products all year long, and I’m genuinely impressed by the array of lowest-ever deals across toys, vacuums, and tech.
 Shop Amazon’s Black Friday Deals 
 After hours of digging through the e-tailer’s sale section, I’m thrilled to see steep markdowns on top-tested vacuums , editor-approved skin and hair care, and even a new record-low price on the Apple AirTag and Watch Series 12 . Plus, after weeks of waiting, I’m finally seeing worthy discounts in the winter fashion and bedding departments.
 Can’t-miss deals:
 Best Apple deal: Apple AirTag $29 $23
 Best tech deal: Blink 2K+ Indoor Camera $40 $16
 Best vacuum deal: Shark Stratos Upright Vacuum $530 $265

 Best toy deal: LEGO Botanicals Daisies Toy $15 $10
 Best fashion deal: Levi’s Classic Straight Jeans $65 $31
